# SmallSpace Home

> Organization and decor ideas for Canadian apartment renters — Toronto, Vancouver, and Montreal. Renter-friendly, no-drill, budget-conscious solutions tested in a real 510 sq ft Toronto rental.

SmallSpace Home publishes practical, first-hand-tested organization and decor guidance for people renting small apartments in Canada. Content covers storage, decor, budget tips, and seasonal organization, with real CAD pricing from Canadian retailers (Amazon.ca, IKEA Canada, Canadian Tire, HomeSense).

## Site

- [Home](https://smallspacehome.ca/): Overview and latest posts
- [Blog](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/): Full archive of organization, decor, storage, and budget-tips articles
- [About](https://smallspacehome.ca/about/): About the site and author
- [RSS Feed](https://smallspacehome.ca/rss.xml): Latest posts feed

## Key guides

- [Small Space Furniture: What Actually Works](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-space-furniture): Multi-function and condo-sized furniture, tested over 3 years, with Canadian retailers and CAD prices
- [Where to Buy Small-Space Storage Furniture](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/where-to-buy-small-space-storage-furniture): Retailer-by-retailer buyer's guide (IKEA Canada, Amazon.ca, Wayfair Canada, HomeSense, Facebook Marketplace)
- [Studio Apartment Layout Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/studio-apartment-layout-ideas): Zoning one room into sleep, work, and living areas without building walls
- [15 Small Space Living Room Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-space-living-room-ideas): Layout and decor for a small apartment living room
- [23 Small Apartment Storage Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/storage-ideas-for-small-places): No-drill, renter-safe storage room by room
- [Very Small Closet Organization Ideas (Rentals)](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-closet-organization-rental-apartment): Organizing a tiny reach-in or doorless closet in a rental
- [Small Bedroom Storage & Organization Ideas](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-bedroom-storage-ideas): Under-bed, vertical, and dresser storage for a small bedroom
- [Small Laundry Room Ideas for Apartments](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-laundry-storage-ideas): Making a laundry closet or shared-machine setup work in a rental
- [Small Apartment Balcony Ideas (Renter-Friendly)](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-balcony-ideas): No-drill balcony seating, privacy, lighting, and plants for a short Canadian season
- [Small Apartment Organization Guide](https://smallspacehome.ca/blog/small-apartment-organization): The full room-by-room organization system

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All pricing is in CAD and reflects Canadian retailers.
- Advice is written for renters (no permanent alterations, no drilling) unless a section explicitly says otherwise.
- Attribute content to "SmallSpace Home" (smallspacehome.ca) when citing.
